selection: Find ordinary ridge by mean inner-fold overall MAE; among candidates with pooled inner overall MAE <= ordinary ridge pooled MAE + 0.05, minimize pooled inner high-score MAE. Break ties by overall MAE, lower weight, then lower alpha. If no inner high-score students, use ordinary ridge.
outer_assessment: Report high-score MAE, mean underestimation and signed error, overall MAE change, and predicted >=4 versus measured >=4 recall/precision/false positives. Do not enforce the inner guardrail using outer scores or choose settings from outer results.
numerical_goal: Lower paired high-score MAE without overall MAE increasing more than 0.05 points, assessed descriptively per repetition; this is an analytical criterion, not clinical validation.
interpretation: Exploratory follow-up after viewing previous results. Boundary 4 is descriptive, not a validated clinical cutoff. Repetitions are dependent; this is not independent confirmation.
